introHtml: Food and beverage items that include a built-in spoon combine convenience with practicality, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate lunches, or employee appreciation gifts. Whether it's a yogurt parfait cup, a soup container, or a portable snack set, the integrated spoon ensures recipients can enjoy their meal anywhere without searching for utensils. Choose from insulated cups with reusable spoons or compostable containers with wooden spoons to align with your brand's sustainability goals. These items keep your logo visible from the first bite to the last.
